CPU host_insert_tasks finishes before task/data/counter H2D copies and launch; no CPU producer feeds the running kernel. Consumed is cudaMalloc/CuArray device memory, and every CTA exits when its fetched index reaches Q. Counter and in-place task data must both be restored on replay.
requirements: Restore consumed counter AND full mutated device task data before every pass; without restoration later passes would execute an exhausted queue.
Preserve selected Q+B sentinel task storage: source fetches queue[next] before testing next<Q. Existing corrected-reference qualification cannot be dropped.
Keep all per-chunk count/task/full-data/guard checks; full timed ROI includes CPU enqueue, copies and observers, not just queue kernel.

rows.reason: GPU writes rows beginning at 2*cpu_tile_offset. CPU computes prefix rows and its H2D copy targets the disjoint prefix. CPU uses separate host input/outputs; it does not service device progress. GPU inputs remain constant. Original CPU/GPU arithmetic overlap is real but does not impose a live handshake.
requirements: Preserve percent-derived tile offset/geometry and disjoint CPU-prefix/GPU-suffix partition; include all full101 percentages and both fixtures in unchanged scientific checks.

Kernel replay may delay return from launch until extra passes complete, removing intended CPU/GPU overlap. Do not interpret instrumented host wall time or kernel sums as original mixed ROI performance.
First-per-geometry captures only representative partition sizes, not101percent timings; preserve actual allocation/memory policy.
rows.measurement_method: Conditional kernel replay for device component counters; timeline or separately reviewed application/range methods for overlap. Original five-run runtime series remains the performance source.

rows.verdict_scope: Idempotent mapped-host vector-add state safety, not generic safety of all mapped/managed memory workloads.
rows.reason: Mapped/registered host A/B are initialized before kernels and remain unchanged until completion; C is overwritten by C=A+B and not read by the kernel. CPU reads C only after CUDA completion and unregister/free follows. Repeated launches are idempotent, with no CPU/GPU same-location live atomics.
requirements: Keep allocations registered/live through every replay pass and completion; preserve mapped-memory pointer type checks and full outputs. Tool compatibility with actual registered/mapped allocations must still be observed, not assumed from source review.

Do not turn near-zero device DRAM bytes into an automatic compute-bound classification. Source operands/results reside in host memory; PCIe/system-memory traffic and caches are a different memory tier.

Classify device-DRAM roofline positioning as qualified/not-applicable for the whole host-memory path unless appropriate host-link/system-memory bytes/ceilings are measured. Cache-control all is an instrumentation policy, not restoration of production residency.
rows.measurement_method: Conditional individual-kernel replay candidate; if active2022.4 rejects mapped allocations, retain tool failure and assess fresh application replay/single-pass collection. For bandwidth analysis measure host-link tier separately; do not silently copy data into device allocations.
